question: Barrel body and the sleeping bag.

options.label: A
options.name: Upright barrel: domed white barrel, visor band, bedroll across the top of the back
options.question: A tall white barrel with a wrap-round visor band; the sleeping bag is a big quilted roll strapped across the top of its back, showing past both shoulders and end-on (its spiral) in profile.
parts: bedroll (path, quilted baffles, two panel straps; spiral end in E/W): layer 0; back; bobs 1 px a frame late on walk and hop, becomes the pillow in nap
boots x2 (panel, void magnet sole, cyan lock light): layer 1; foot; 6-frame clomp, lock light on at contact
legs x2 (panel pistons): layer 1; hip; short swing, tucked in hop and sit
barrel (hull_warm dome, hull body, hull_cool skirt, panel hoop): layer 2; hip; breath 1 px squash
visor band (void glass, lamp eyes): layer 3; chest; eyes swap per state (half-lid, closed + z, ! hit)
chest (seam, vent slots, lamp + cyan lights): layer 3; chest; lights pulse in cast
arms x2 (hull_warm, panel shoulder ball and mitten): layer 4; chest; swing, wind-up, strike, guard
options.pose: Upright and patient as a night-light, arms at its sides: on call for whoever cannot sleep.
notes: Works: the crossbar roll over a plain barrel is unlike any folk; the spiral end reads as "sleeping bag".
The slow blink is a lamp eye going from half-lid to a closed U and a small z on the visor.
Risk: very symmetric and static; the stubby arms limit strike poses, so fights lean on the boots.
Compared with Eastward 05: the white caravans and kiosks (pale plates, violet seams, lit upper-left rims).

options.label: B
options.name: Squat capsule: porthole visor, antenna lamp, the bag worn as a cape with a rolled collar
options.question: A wide egg-shaped capsule with a round porthole visor; the sleeping bag worn as a cape whose top is rolled into a thick collar, its quilted tail flaring past both sides.
parts: cape (path quilt baffles, plaster lining turned down in the snuggle, scalloped hem): layer 0; chest (collar); sways 1 px late, wraps the body in nap
boots x2 (panel half-domes, void magnet sole, cyan light): layer 1; foot; waddle walk, no legs
capsule (hull dome, hull_cool skirt, seam, chest hatch): layer 2; hip; breath 1 px
porthole (panel bezel with 4 rivets, void glass, lamp eyes): layer 3; head; eyes swap per state
antenna (panel stalk, lamp tip): layer 3; head; springs back on hop and hit
collar roll (path and path_warm, quilted): layer 4; chest; the perch for the familiar
ball arms x2 (hull_warm, panel claws): layer 5; chest; swing, punch, hold the cape in guard
options.pose: Squat and snug, wrapped up like it is always a little cold on the station.
notes: Works: a bell shape with a collar is the cosiest read; the snuggle fidget is pure Bunk.
Risk: the porthole + antenna lean towards a generic toy robot; no legs makes the 6-frame walk a waddle.
The cape tail must not read as a skirt: hem scallops and quilt folds carry it.
Compared with Eastward 05: the white port-a-cabins (round port, bezel rivets) and the quilted jackets.

options.label: C
options.name: Hooped barrel: helmet head with a half-moon visor, Sleep Cycle dial, bag roll at the hips
options.question: A helmet head with a half-moon visor on a barrel torso with two panel hoops and the Sleep Cycle dial on the chest; the sleeping bag a roll strapped low across the back at the hips.
parts: bag roll (path, quilted, plaster lining at the spiral end): layer 0; hip (back); unrolls as a flap in the fidget, spreads under it in nap
disc feet x2 (panel, void magnet sole, cyan light): layer 1; foot; heavy flat clomp
legs x2 (panel pistons): layer 1; hip; 6-frame swing
barrel torso (hull, two panel hoops with rivets): layer 2; hip; breath 1 px
dial (panel bezel, void face, lamp sector, needle): layer 3; chest; sector shows deep/dream stage
head (hull_warm helmet, brow, half-moon visor, lamp eyes, panel ear pods): layer 4; chest; tilts 1 px in idle, nods in the blink
arms x2 (hull + hull_cool segments, panel elbow and hand): layer 5; chest; full swing, strike, cast
options.pose: Neat and attentive, head up and the dial showing: it keeps everyone's sleep on schedule.
notes: Works: the most rig-friendly (separate head, real arms and legs) and the dial puts the mechanic on the body.
Risk: head + body + limbs is the most generic robot shape, closest to Pendle and Nix in outline.
The barrel reads from the hoops; the bag at the hips is less visible from the front.
Compared with Eastward 05: the trailer's white panels and its banded hoops/rails at the same height.

final.name: Upright barrel (final): one white cylinder, curved visor band, dial hatch, bedroll shelf
grafts: From C: the Sleep Cycle dial on a recessed chest hatch: panel bezel, deep half lit lamp, dream half dark glass, needle at twelve; the halves swap in the dream stage (the fidget shows it), it brightens in a cast.
From B: the bag pulled round the front as the nap sit-down (lining turned down, mittens holding the edge, boot toes out under the hem); the cyan boot lock lights in every view.

Fix: one cylinder: warm lit band (hull_warm 4) with a sheen streak (5) in the left third, hull 3, then hull_cool 3, 2 and a violet east edge 1; no vertical chest seam; dome rim, visor band and hoop curve round the front.
Fix: the roll sits lower, behind the shoulders (top at the dome's third row); end on it is a quilted spiral with plaster lining, crossed by a panel strap and buckle: a roll, not an ear.
Fix: profiles as forms: the dome rim a brow, the visor glass a pixel proud, a lit sill as the chin step, the band's back end in shade as the cheek.
parts: familiar perch: on top of the bedroll, the side away from the foe (E: x smaller, W: x larger); layer -1; back

bedroll (path quilt, path_cool end, plaster lining, panel straps and buckles): layer 0; back (shoulders); S: crossbar behind the shoulders; E/W: end on behind the dome; same anchor and layer every facing; unrolls round the front in the nap
far leg + boot / far arm (panel, hull_warm, a tone back): layer 1; hip / chest; E/W
barrel (one cylinder: hull_warm lit band and sheen, hull, hull_cool shade; curved rim seam, panel hoop): layer 2; hip; leans with the pose (shear), breath 1 px squash
visor band (void glass, lamp eyes per state: open, closed + z, focus, wide, squeeze, happy): layer 3; head (dome); the slow blink is the signature
chest hatch + Sleep Cycle dial (panel bezel, lamp/void halves, needle): layer 3; chest; stage swaps, brightens in cast; edge-on bezel proud of the front in E/W
near leg + magnetic boot (panel piston, panel boot, void magnet sole, cyan lock light): layer 4; hip; 6-frame clomp, tucked in cheer, forward in sit
near arm (panel shoulder ball, hull_warm arm, panel mitten; the forearm telescopes in the strike): layer 5; chest; swing, wind-up, strike at full reach, cast up, guard
final.pose: Upright and patient as a night-light, arms at its sides: on call for whoever cannot sleep.
notes: Compared side by side with Eastward 05 at the same height: the white caravans and kiosks (one pale cylinder or plate lit in a band, violet seams, lit upper-left rims) and the quilted jackets of the townsfolk.
Works: a barrel under a bedroll crossbar is unlike every folk; the familiar sits on the roll as a shelf, clear of the visor, in every fight pose.
Risk: a rigid barrel; poses come from lean, the telescoping arm and the boots. The nap is a sit-down, not a lying barrel (cheaper and keeps the visor blink visible).
Open for Matt: amber lamp eyes, never cyan glyphs (Nix owns those); the familiar's size on the roll.
